title: SummaryField
description: Learner-facing blurb on word and sentence results (distinct from connections.notes, which carries Lewis & Short main_notes).

summary.description: Optional learning and quick-reference note. Empty string until filled (often by an agent). Primary use: prepositions with the noun case(s) they govern, and verbs with the case(s) their objects or complements take. Not a substitute for connections.notes (etymology, see also, dictionary prose).
